articles.title: Asian Stocks to Fall as Iran Flare-Up Boosts Oil: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Global bonds fell, pushing yields to multi-decade highs, as concern over quicker inflation boosted bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month. Oil climbed as geopolitical tensions flared.
